meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要快速美化 Markdown 文档的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly beautify Markdown document formatting

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的文章内容，自动添加标题、加粗重点、整理列表和代码块，并修复排版问题，最后生成一份格式更清晰的新文件。
howto.when: 当你要求“格式化 Markdown”、“美化文章”、“添加格式”或改善文章布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我格式化这篇 Markdown 文章。
say.note: Claude 会分析并优化格式，输出新文件。

say.text: 美化一下这份笔记的排版。
say.note: Claude 会添加标题、列表等，让笔记更易读。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your article, adds headings, bolds key points, organizes lists and code blocks, fixes typography issues, and outputs a better-formatted file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this markdown article for me.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and optimize formatting, outputting a new file.

say_en.text: Beautify the layout of these notes.
say_en.note: Claude will add headings, lists, etc., making notes more readable.
